items.author: jo.vasquez.ink
items.body: flash day sept 13 at the shop!! new sheet is up. 12 designs, first come first serve, $120-$180 each. the moth with the switchblade is my favorite thing ive drawn all year so somebody please get it lol. drew the whole sheet over like 3 weekends at my kitchen table

items.author: jo.vasquez.ink
items.body: flash day recap: 9 out of 12 gone, the switchblade moth went in the first hour. still have the snake & peony, the cherry bomb and the little ghost cowboy if anybody wants one. thank you all for coming out

items.author: deb.kowalczyk
items.body: ok dont be mad at me for being the messenger but isnt this your moth?? my niece sent it to me, she bought one for her water bottle. shop is called StickerBurrow Co, its listed as 'Knife Moth Vinyl Decal' $6.50 or 3 for $15. like its EXACTLY yours down to the little crack in the blade

items.author: jo.vasquez.ink
items.body: hi, the knife moth decal you are selling is my design from my sept flash sheet, I have the original drawing and the post from august 30. please take it down. I didnt give anyone permission to print it

items.author: stickerburrow.co
items.body: Hey! Love your work. Our artists create original designs inspired by trending styles. Moths are a very common tattoo motif and we can't remove listings based on similarity alone. If you have a registered copyright feel free to send it through our support form. Have a great day!

items.author: tyler.saltandsparrow
items.body: hey just so you know before tomorrow, I talked to Ruben again. we're $2,140 short on december rent after the compressor repair. he said he'd give us till the 8th. dont post about the shop money stuff anywhere ok, I dont want clients thinking we're closing. we'll figure it out
